title: NewGen Executes Share Purchase Agreement and Obtains Exclusive APAC Agency Rights with K25.ai, an AI-Powered Prediction Market Led by Industry Veteran Andy Cheung
summary: Bernstein projects prediction markets at $1T by 2030; NewGenIVF takes 2% of K25.ai for $2M plus APAC agency role and option to raise its stake to 10%.

**


Pattern Detected


NIVF has shown strong positive reactions to prior AI-related K25.ai announcements.


**


Recent Company History


Over recent months, NewGenIVF reported fiscal 2025 results with total assets of **US$32.7 million** and a **US$2 million** share repurchase authorization, filed its **2025 Form 20-F** , and pursued partnerships such as a women’s health Web3 initiative. On **May 21, 2026** , an AI-tagged strategic investment and exclusive APAC agency agreement with K25.ai at a **US$100 million** valuation drove a **51.54%** one-day move. Today’s execution-focused K25.ai agreements continue that AI diversification theme.
